title: 16.1 Tomahawk5: 51.2Tb/s 5nm Monolithic Switch Chip for AI/ML Networking
problem: Next-generation data center and AI networks demand switching capacity beyond previous generation (25.6Tb/s); monolithic integration at scale requires advanced SerDes technology supporting diverse optical/copper connectivity options while achieving 51.2Tb/s in 5nm.
motivation: Explosive growth in AI/ML workloads and data center interconnect demands create need for next-generation high-capacity, flexible switch architectures.
method: Tomahawk5 monolithic switch chip integrating 51.2Tb/s switching fabric with Peregrine SerDes cores supporting multiple physical connectivity options: direct-attach copper, front-panel optics, linear-pluggable optics, and co-packaged optics.
key_novelty: Integrated Peregrine SerDes enabling flexible multi-protocol optical/copper connectivity in monolithic 51.2Tb/s switch.
contributions: 5nm monolithic integration for data center AI/ML
primary_theme: High-capacity monolithic switch for AI/ML data centers
